construction.implementation_origin: New implementation authored within this isolated build

shared_schema.input: Exact fields: schema_version integer 1, synthetic true, requirements[], evidence[], questions[]. IDs unique within each collection. All references resolve.
shared_schema.evidence: id, source, locator, text; all nonempty strings
shared_schema.questions: id, text, nonempty requirement_ids[]; explicit caller-scoped retrieval
shared_schema.review: schema_version, notice, findings[] with requirement_id, status supported|gap, missing_phrases[], citations[]
shared_schema.review_citation: phrase, evidence_id, source, locator, quote (entire verbatim evidence text)
shared_schema.faq: schema_version, answers[] with question_id, requirement_ids, status answered|abstained, reason, gap_requirement_ids, answer, citations[]
shared_schema.validation: Shared strict object, text, collection and reference validators; canonical reconstruction validates intermediate and final outputs, including grounding and propagation. Unknown fields, duplicate JSON keys and non-finite JSON numbers rejected.

cross_stage_handoffs.payload: Validated findings with requirement IDs, coverage statuses, missing phrases and traceable evidence quotations
cross_stage_handoffs.contract: FAQ revalidates the entire review against original input before retrieving exclusively from supported findings. Any scoped gap forces abstention.

behavior.review: Case-insensitive literal phrase matching with Unicode word boundaries across explicitly linked evidence; each phrase needs at least one hit. Missing evidence creates traceable gaps.
behavior.faq: Extractive retrieval ranked by count of distinct overlapping casefolded word tokens after a fixed stop-word filter. Ties break by evidence ID. All positively ranked evidence returned once. Answers are verbatim full evidence excerpts.
behavior.abstention: Any scoped review gap yields review_gap; otherwise no token overlap yields no_relevant_evidence. Abstentions have null answers and no citations.
behavior.cli: One JSON object on stdout. Success exits 0; usage, file, JSON and validation errors return status error and exit 2.
behavior.synthetic_fixture: Synthetic shop return policy is supported; refund timing is incomplete; unrelated tracking question abstains.
behavior.limitations: Coverage is lexical, not semantic entailment. Negation, contradictory policies, truthfulness, question completeness and real-world compliance are not inferred. Retrieval overlap is a relevance heuristic, not confidence. No certification claims.

test_outcomes.cli_status: passed; emitted one JSON object with status ok and exited 0
